fullPassage: More often than not, decision-making involves observing the choices of others. A team of researchers conducted an experiment to see how the hesitation of others in decision-making can affect an individual’s choice in a group setting. The participants sat at computers that displayed the same virtual bag filled with three balls, marked with either the letter “A” or “B.” They took turns pulling out one ball and guessing whether the bag contained more “A” or “B” balls. They could see the guesses made by those who went before them but couldn’t see the actual letters on the earlier balls. The results showed that participants were twice as likely to make a different guess if the previous participants exhibited reluctance in making their guess. This hesitancy was perceived as a lack of confidence, which prompted subsequent participants to disregard the previous choices of the group. Instead, they made guesses based on their own information —the letter on the ball they pulled. These findings suggest that reluctance in decision-making can interfere with groupthink and allow for a more individualized decision-making process.

④ ignore(무시하다) ✅ 정답 — disregard와 동의어
det.tip: disregard(무시하다) = ignore(무시하다)

questions.passage: More often than not, decision-making involves observing the choices of others. A team of researchers conducted an experiment to see how the hesitation of others in decision-making can affect an individual’s choice in a group setting. The participants sat at computers that displayed the same virtual bag filled with three balls, marked with either the letter “A” or “B.” They took turns pulling out one ball and guessing whether the bag contained more “A” or “B” balls. They could see the guesses made by those who went before them but couldn’t see the actual letters on the earlier balls. The results showed that participants were twice as likely to make a different guess if the previous participants exhibited reluctance in making their guess. This hesitancy was perceived as a lack of confidence, which prompted <u>subsequent</u> participants to disregard the previous choices of the group. Instead, they made guesses based on their own information —the letter on the ball they pulled. These findings suggest that reluctance in decision-making can interfere with groupthink and allow for a more individualized decision-making process.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 subsequent와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
subsequent는 '이후의, 뒤따르는'이라는 뜻으로, 그 반대는 '앞선, 이전의'를 뜻하는 preceding
① preceding(앞선) ✅ 정답 — subsequent의 반의어
② following(뒤따르는) — subsequent와 비슷한 뜻이라 반대가 아님
③ later(나중의) — subsequent와 비슷한 뜻으로 반대가 아님
④ frequent(잦은) — 빈도 개념이라 순서와 무관한 다른 의미축
det.tip: subsequent(이후의) ↔ preceding(앞선)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 hesitation과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:

① confusion(혼란) — 혼란스러움을 뜻해 반대 관계가 아님

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis:
빈칸은 앞 명사 computers를 꾸미는 관계사절 'that ____ the same virtual bag'의 동사 자리예요. 문장 전체가 sat(앉았다)이라는 과거로 서술되므로 시제를 맞춰 과거형 displayed가 정답이에요

det.analysis:

동사원형 guess를 그대로 두면 pulling과 형태가 달라 병렬이 깨져요
